title: Localize RepeatIntervalCountStepper's label and count text
description: Replace the hardcoded 'Repeat every' label and the manually-pluralized count text (which mishandled anything but a hand-rolled 's' suffix) with resource-backed lookups, using real <plurals> for the count text.
acceptance_criteria: The count text comes from pluralStringResource (repeat_count_days/weeks/months depending on interval) instead of manual string-template pluralization
The '-'/'+' step button glyphs are left as-is (not language-dependent, no resource needed)
No other logic in the function is changed
name: RepeatIntervalCountStepper
